schema.trigger: 'scheduled' with the piece count, or the specific failure that prompted it
schema.provision: the rule considered, named as it appears in policy.html
schema.was: the rule before the change; null where nothing changed
schema.now: the rule after the change; null where nothing changed
schema.evidence: array of piece identifiers from the archive, e.g. ['12', '19', 'C3']
schema.reviewed_by: model name giving the second opinion
schema.second_opinion: the reviewing model's assessment, recorded in full
schema.reverses: review number this entry reverses, or null
schema.published: URL of the amendment article, or null

reviews.now: The journal amends its own policy under the procedure in the Amendment section of policy.html, subject to four fixed provisions.
reviews.second_opinion: Not applicable. This entry records the founding state of the policy rather than an amendment made under it.
